name: Ascend 950PR
description: Hardware topology, theoretical limits, and absolute-cost-model priors for Ascend950PR/dav-c310. Values are not all board measurements; consult field_metadata and calibration.description.

hardware_identity.description: Product model is reported by torch/installed platform config; npu_arch_id=3510 is the ACL architecture number rather than the model name; dav-c310 is the compiler code-generation architecture.

ub.description: Physical UB is 256 KiB. AscendNPU-IR reserves 8 KiB for the compiler, so the platform/compiler allocation limit and the loader-facing size_kb are 248 KiB. ACL_DEV_ATTR_UBUF_PER_VECTOR_CORE separately reports 221184 bytes (216 KiB); that runtime-query value is recorded but is not substituted for the compiler allocation limit.

size_kb.description: Compiler-usable capacity: physical 256 KiB minus the explicit 8 KiB compiler reservation.
size_kb.source: Installed CANN Ascend950PR_9579.ini ub_size=253952 and AscendNPU-IR Ascend950_BaseSpec UbSize=248KiB

cube.description: Cube matrix engine topology, theoretical arithmetic rates, supported fractal shapes, and memory-space contract.

vector.description: One AIV has a 256-byte vector register (64 FP32 elements per instruction). width_elements is a legacy steady-state elements-per-compute-cycle estimate, not a register lane count.

width_elements.description: 128 FP32 adds per configured compute cycle is consistent with 3.30 vector-add/SYS_CNT-tick * 64 / 1.65. This is saturated ADD throughput, not a dtype-independent instruction width or a latency.
width_elements.source: PR tput sweep 2026-09-12; isolated SYS_CNT approximately 1000 MHz; configured compute 1650 MHz

tflops_fp32.description: Legacy generic peak; cannot be validated by ADD-only throughput or applied as per-core without a scope.
tflops_fp32.source: Inherited absolute-model input; pending operation/scope validation

tflops_fp16.description: Legacy generic peak; pending FP16-specific measurement and scope validation.

inter_path.description: Cube and Vector paths execute in parallel

intra_path.description: All units within each path can execute in parallel (pipelined)

memory_cycles.description: Nominal bandwidth-plus-latency formula; not currently consumed from this block.

calibration.description: Partial 950PR correction, 2026-09-12: capacities and topology verified against Ascend950PR_9579; 1650 MHz is configured compute frequency. Legacy startup, scalar, barrier and bandwidth priors are not newly calibrated. Several documentary fields are not consumed by the loader; consult each description.

startup_latencies.description: Absolute-model startup priors. The current JSON loader does not read this object; corresponding getters still use C++ defaults.

vector_op_cycles_per_vec_instruction.description: Legacy per-vector-instruction cycle priors. This is the only calibration sub-object currently consumed by HardwareConfig::loadFromJSON.

scalar_overhead.description: Observed scalar/compute ratios retained as calibration evidence; the current JSON loader does not consume these fields.
